title: Markolino-Chaos
description: a fun plugin for Paper that spawns "Markolino" a bot that wants to kill you!
body:
# MarkolinoChaos

Just a plugin that adds Markolino to your server. He's your new friend.

He spawns, he follows you around, he stares at you. Most of the time he just walks, but sometimes he gets bored. He might wants to hit you. He might wants you dead. He's just bored don't mind him, really, you better not stay near him...
He might break blocks to reach you. He might open your chests and steal your items. He might place TNT at your feet and run away.

**Features**
*   **Stalker AI**: He follows players and watches them from a distance.
*   **Thief**: He steals items from chests and can snatch weapons from your hands.
*   **Sabotage**: Places TNT and cobwebs when you aren't looking (configurable).
*   **Paranormal**: Rarely, he can strike you with lightning, change your player size, or mess with the server tick rate.
*   **The Hydra**: If you kill him, two more will spawn. Don't kill him.

**Commands**
*   `/markolino spawn` - Spawns him. (you can also add a number to spawn more! The maximum is 50 though)
*   `/markolino killall` - Removes them all.
*   `/markolino settings` - Toggle his ability to use TNT, steal, or use god powers.

To use the commands you NEED to be opped!

**Dependencies**
*   Citizens
*   ProtocolLib
